document_metadata.document_title: Department of Water Engineering Design Standards — Section 5 Storm Water Requirements

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Peak-rate control: post-development peak runoff ≤ pre-development for all 24-hour storms from 1-year through the critical year storm; detention volume methods based on percent increase in 1-year 24-hour runoff volume. Post-construction BMPs per Ohio EPA Construction General Permit OHC000002 (SWP3 Part III) with O&M manuals required. Section is conveyance/detention focused rather than a standalone WQv rainfall-depth manual.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Detention: post ≤ pre for 24-hr storms 1-year through critical year
approved_bmp_categories: Post-construction BMPs per Ohio EPA CGP
